LanguageData.VREStarjack_Hyperoxia.description: This creature is suffering from oxygen toxicity caused by exposure to a breathable atmosphere. Their lungs cannot tolerate this much oxygen. They will die soon unless removed to a low-oxygen or vacuum environment.
LanguageData.VREStarjack_Hyperoxia.label: hyperoxia
LanguageData.VREStarjack_Hyperoxia.stages.0.label: initial
LanguageData.VREStarjack_Hyperoxia.stages.1.label: initial
LanguageData.VREStarjack_Hyperoxia.stages.2.label: mild
LanguageData.VREStarjack_Hyperoxia.stages.3.label: moderate
LanguageData.VREStarjack_Hyperoxia.stages.4.label: extreme
LanguageData.VREStarjack_OxygenSensitivity_Extreme.de: This person cannot survive in oxygen-rich environments. Exposure to breathable atmospheres causes rapid lung failure and eventual death. Only the vacuum of space or low-oxygen gravship environments can sustain them.
LanguageData.VREStarjack_OxygenSensitivity_Intense.de: This person suffers severe discomfort and reduced bodily function in oxygenated environments. Exposure to breathable air causes pain, weakness, and labored breathing, making planetary survival difficult.
LanguageData.VREStarjack_OxygenSensitivity_Mild.descr: This person is slightly averse to oxygen-rich environments. In breathable atmosphere, they experience minor respiratory and neurological strain, accompanied by a subtle discomfort with each breath.
LanguageData.VREStarjack_OxygenSensitivity_Mild.label: mild oxygen sensitivity
